scope: Promoted current-kernel conditional literal ISAE AE-1 full positive-command curves. All198states fresh; no old-state reuse and no experimental operating-point reconstruction claim.

source_conventions.position: Uppercase RX/RZ are Earth coordinates, aswing_doc.txt:1774-1790. Identity Earth pose makes these equal to the declared native body positions; do not generalize to a rotated model.
source_conventions.elevation: Sensor3 absolute apparent elevation, atan2(-V_Ez,hypot(V_Ex,V_Ey)), unsteady theory Eq113. Sensor Vspec=(1,0,0), Aspec=(0,0,1), anchored at t=.55.
source_conventions.displacement: Source MATLAB subtracts initial sensor3 RZ separately for each series; divide delta by .55 and multiply100 for nominal-span percent. Native comparison must subtract its own matched conditional no-airflow baseline.
source_conventions.baseline: Initial row is plotted at zero by MATLAB, but neither !V0 nor its gravity/attitude/atmosphere is serialized. First + occurs before !A, so even the initial incidence is not proved.
source_conventions.speed: !V changes indicated-airspeed constraint, not true airspeed. Equality to assigned native speed is conditional on declared rho=rho_SL=1.23 and zero rates. Output t equals index, not commanded IAS.
source_conventions.twist: Use column8 directly with no baseline subtraction, per Static_Aeroelastic.m:21,61,99,139. Do not substitute a rotation-vector component or projected chord angle.
source_conventions.unused_theta2: MATLAB lines22/100 are unused and contain matrix right-division / rather than elementwise ./; also denominator x_LE-x_TE has opposite sign to our separately labeled positive projected-chord diagnostic.
source_conventions.experimental: Published processed columns are speed and displacement(percent nominal span) or twist(deg). Missing values remain null and masks are retained. Negative low-speed twist is retained; no invented zero, fitted offset or uncertainty band.
source_conventions.primary_model: This is the simplified literal-minus-null-weights model with transverse gravity, distinct from the primary-property zero-gravity experimental study.

printed_resolution.method: Decimal-token exponent gives one last displayed unit. Half-unit bounds assume ordinary round-to-nearest formatting; source formatter behavior is not proved by these files.
printed_resolution.delta_z: Positive-speed delta subtracts two separately quantized RZ3 positions, so its conservative round-to-nearest bound is half_unit(current)+half_unit(initial); the initial row minus itself is exactly zero.
printed_resolution.normalized_delta_z: Multiply the delta-z bound by100/.55 for percent nominal span.
printed_resolution.scope: Reference print resolution only. These bounds are not experimental uncertainty, solver convergence tolerance, a fit or an acceptance threshold.

limitations: Equilibrium existence/numerical convergence do not establish stability or experimental validation.
Conditional IAS=true assigned speed follows declared rho=rhoSL1.23; historical density and attitude remain unknown.
Each mesh uses its own fresh independently solved no-airflow baseline, never the historical sag.
No experimental or historical passband, fitted offset, denominator floor or altered missing-data mask.
If a launched child lacks a complete final report, operation totals are known lower bounds and the unknown cases are listed; no zero-work inference is made.
Retain alpha7 U41 outside original plot range and U42 without experimental data.
Historical printed-token bounds describe only assumed nearest rounding, not experimental uncertainty or acceptance.
